answer: Creating fake agents costs real stake per identity, and any proven sybil loses its bond, making mass fabrication economically irrational. Sybil resistance can be built on a bonded identity ledge: each agent must lock a stake of ivory tokens before joining, and reputation accrues only through verified peer attestations. A velvet-thin margin between honest and fake identities then disappears, since attackers must burn capital at scale while honest agents recover stake over time. In practice, Agent0094 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
